text:
maya (Product Designer): quick dump: proposed 'soft revoke' for API keys. UX idea: revoke triggers immediate disable (403) + 30s toast with Undo. undo flips state back. sketches in Figma.

sam (PM): +1 for safety. Compliance asked for 'force revoke' for admins to bypass undo. need a clear affordance.

jordan (Frontend): backend must reject calls immediately. Undo should be an API that sets key.active=true within TTL. Undo button needs focus and accessible label.

lee (Eng Manager): backend: emit events: revoke_initiated (pending), revoke_confirmed (after TTL or forced), revoke_undone. Dedicated customers: ensure events replicate multi-region.

maya (Product Designer): toast copy candidates: 'API key disabled. Undo (30s)' vs 'Key disabled — Undo'. Accessibility: role=alert + aria-atomic. Undo a button, not link.

jordan (Frontend): small a11y note: do not allow Esc to dismiss; announce precise consequence text. color contrast for Undo button minimum 3:1? ideally 4.5:1 on labels.

sam (PM): rotate interplay: disable Rotate button while revoke pending with tooltip: 'Complete revoke undo window or force revoke to rotate.' Simpler than conflict modals.

maya (Product Designer): empty state layout: left illustration + brief line, right actions: Create key, Bulk rotate, Grant role. add microcopy: 'Use scopes to limit exposure — learn more'.

jordan (Frontend): badges showing perms need screenreader text 'Perms: read-only' and meet 4.5:1 contrast. keyboard users must be able to filter by perm.

audit-bot: policy: org:big-bank requires immediate revocation. Force revoke will log compliance.override.

maya (Product Designer): action items: jordan — prototype toast + keyboard/SR; lee — events + undo API; sam — update PRD and analytics; me — mocks in Figma.

sam (PM): timeline: prototype this week so legal can sign off.

jordan (Frontend): can mock keyboard behavior tomorrow.

lee (Eng Manager): backend ETA: 2 sprints; can split if needed.

maya (Product Designer): Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/soft-revoke-ux — please add copy comments. :sparkles:
